title: Anyone else messing around with Jex AI on Local Trade?
author: Plastic-Bluejay5047
selftext: Been testing beta for a few days now. mostly using it when I'm looking at market stuff and want a quick second opinion without opening 15 tabs lol. it's definitely still beta though. sometimes answers is useful, sometimes i have to ask the same thing differently cause it misses what i mean. wouldn't use it as some tell me what to buy machine either. anyone been using it longer?
